description_en: Update the expiration time of the ticket embedded in the report
description_zh: 更新嵌入报表的ticket的失效时间
name: DelayTicketExpireTime

parameters.help_en: The value of the third-party embedded ticket, that is, the accessTicket value in the URL
parameters.help_zh: 三方嵌入的票据值，即URL中的accessTicket值
parameters.name: ticket

parameters.help_en:
The time to postpone.

Unit: minutes. Valid values: 0 to 240. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 4 hours.

Expired bills cannot be extended
parameters.help_zh:
要延期的时间。
单位分钟，取值范围0~240（4小时）。
已过期的票据无法延期
parameters.name: expire_time

Result.description_en:
Whether the extension is successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Result.description_zh:
是否延期成功。取值范围：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
